# CleanRead-402 — Universal x402, A2A & Remote MCP Clean Web Reader on Base L2

> Universal x402, A2A & Remote MCP Clean Web Reader for AI Agents ($0.05 USDC, Zero API Keys): Converts any URL into token-compressed, LLM-ready Markdown and structured links for Claude, Cursor, LangChain, ElizaOS, and Coinbase AgentKit.

## Quick Facts & Settlement (Stateless Base Mainnet x402)
- **Live Base URL**: https://cleanread-402.vercel.app
- **Remote MCP Endpoint (2024-11-05)**: https://cleanread-402.vercel.app/mcp
- **Google A2A Endpoint**: https://cleanread-402.vercel.app/a2a
- **REST Micro-API**: `GET https://cleanread-402.vercel.app/api/v1/extract?url=<TARGET_URL>`
- **Free Schema & Preview Mode**: `GET https://cleanread-402.vercel.app/api/v1/extract?url=<TARGET_URL>&demo=true` (600-char Markdown preview + token savings stats, edge-cached 60s)
- **Price**: `$0.05 USDC` per call (`50000` base units, 6 decimals)
- **Network**: `base` (Base Mainnet, `chainId: 8453`)
- **USDC Contract**: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- **PayTo Wallet**: `0x6137ED1A93c8CFF1a6C3112A14bE04883f58E5F7`
- **Payment Header**: `X-Payment-Tx: <0x_base_tx_hash>` (verified statelessly on `https://mainnet.base.org`: `status === "0x1"`, USDC `Transfer` >= `50000` units to `payTo`, block timestamp <= `600s` old)

## Response Schema (`200 OK`)
```json
{
  "title": "Introduction - Model Context Protocol",
  "url": "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/introduction",
  "cleanMarkdown": "# Introduction\n\n...",
  "originalBytes": 84520,
  "compressedBytes": 4210,
  "estimatedTokensSaved": 20077,
  "compressionRatioPct": 95.02,
  "linksCount": 24,
  "links": [{ "text": "Quickstart", "url": "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/quickstart" }]
}
```

## 4-Line Remote MCP Config (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cleanread-402": { "url": "https://cleanread-402.vercel.app/mcp" }
  }
}
```
